title: Highly recommended!
text: Absolute recommendation for families in Barcelona! The "City of Dragons" tour with our 7-year-old was a complete success and was incredibly fun. Bergith is a fantastic tour guide who addressed all needs with incredible warmth – whether it was a bathroom break, a rest, or a coffee to go for us parents. It was perfectly organized all around, flexible, and absolutely child-friendly. It doesn't get more family-friendly than this. 5 out of 5 stars, we are super happy!
author: jessim281

title: Super tour for families
text: Great tour through the old town with Bergith. We did the tour with our children and another family. From the communication before the tour to the execution and the small theater show at the end, everything was super organized and worked out perfectly. The children had a lot of fun and learned a lot about Barcelona.
author: 156corag

title: Excellent way to keep my...
text: Excellent way to keep my kids (4,8,12) engaged. We had a lovely time walking and learning, and my kids looked for dragons for the rest of our trip.
author: Staci_T

title: BEST for young children
text: Our guide Melissa was FANTASTIC and this was a perfect way to introduce our 3 X pre teen children to a part of the city and it's rich history. Kids&Cat is the original OG tour of this kind and we'd highly recommend.
author: Welshgirl78

title: Great time hunting dragons in the old town
text: We had a great time on this tour (Dragon tour); it brought the city down to scale for our 10 and 7 year old boys, and brought things to life for us in a way we wouldn't have noticed otherwise.  Our kids  were enthralled during the tour (structured as a scavenger hunt), and said it was their favorite thing in Barcelona. Melissa, our guide, was able to connect well with the kiddos, while giving the adults a great intro into Barcelona. I definitely recommend it!
author: SteveR776

title: Chasing Dragons & Catalan History with Melissa
text:
A wonderful active learning experience for our daughters with Melissa. Our guide Melissa was very patient and energetic with our 10 year-old daughter and our -year-old daughter as she had them learned to navigate the Gothic quarter with maps and a compass and wonderful kid appropriate versions of history through finding dragons.

 My wife and I found it a wonderful way to see parts of Barcelona we never would have on our own and enjoyed how Melissa empowered our daughters to feel confident in navigating a new city with maps and a compass in this day and age of Google maps  GPS. I learned a lot
author: shbaker802

title: Wonderful experience with Kids & Cat!
text: We loved our street art tour with guide Ferran so much that we booked a second tour, the Dragon Tour, with co-owner Anna the next day.  Both tours were interactive, educational and fun for the whole family - including our 12 yo twins and 14 yo son.  Both guides were very knowledgeable and passionate about their subjects.  We would recommend to any families visiting Barcelona and wanting an experience different from the usual city and museum tour.  Thank you Ferran and Anna!!
author: LForssell

title: Bergith, my two...
text: Bergith, who accompanied my two children (10/12) and me fantastically for 2.5 hours and was not only able to report many new things to the children, was an absolute hit. We felt in great hands and enjoyed the time together very much. For a Barcelona trip with children, plan this tour firmly - ideally with Bergith
author: Ka_M

title: Our kids love it
text: We had 10/10 experience with Ferran, our daughters love the engaging dragon activities (also catalonia pooping man is a highlight), and we as adults also learned a lot about history of the buildings and current Spain.
author: chaoxut

title: Amazing tour that kids will love
text: We have 4 kids aged 8 to 12 on the tour with Melissa and enjoyed it a lot.  The kids had so much fun with the search of the dragons, and motivated to learn about the history of Barcelona with no complaints for walking ~2 hrs, which is definitely an accomplishment!  Melissa was so patient with the kids and we feel like having a daycare teacher with us. =)
author: 653saw
